text:
Maria (Marketing): Quick heads-up — Meridian case study needs final quote sign-off and an embargo/window for the webinar publish. Can @Jess, @Owen, @LegalBot and @Sam confirm availability?

Jess (Content): I have the draft interview Qs and a first-pass story. Can we schedule the customer interview next Tue morning? Need 48h after interview to prep transcript + redlines.

Owen (PM): Product will pull the benchmark pack (p50/p95 latency + cost numbers) and a short implementation note. I can get that to Jess by EOD today.

Sam (Sales): Customer prefers an embargo until Tue 12pm PT so they can coordinate internal comms. Also they asked if we can do a short joint webinar within two weeks of publish.

Jess (Content): Proposed publish & promo plan (quick):
```
- Blog post (800-1000 words)
- 1 LinkedIn post + 1 X post
- 30-min webinar (customer + product lead)
- Promo email to 40k list (segment: PMs, infra)
```
Need legal sign-off on quotes and permissions before outreach.

LegalBot: Reminder — we require a signed release form and explicit approval on customer quote snippets. Please send the final quote text to legal@redwood.com. Typical turnaround 24-48h. If embargo requested, put that in the email subject.

Maria (Marketing): Sounds good. @Owen please attach the numbers Josh needs for the webinar deck. @Jess I'll tentatively book Tue 10am PT for the interview.

Jess (Content): Booking note: interview length 45m (30m for Qs + 15m for recording soundbites). Will send calendar invite once Owen confirms data pack.

Owen (PM): Sending the datapack now: includes p50/p95 latency over last 30 days, cost/unit estimates, and an integration timeline blurb.

Sam (Sales): Confirming customer ok with Tue 10am PT. They'll send a quick bio + headshot after interview.

Maria (Marketing): Quick draft quote for legal review: "Redwood Inference cut our inference costs by ~35% and reduced 99th pct latency by 20ms, enabling faster UX for our customers."

Jess (Content): I'll attach the transcript + proposed quote text to the legal email.

LegalBot: Received. Tagging for Nina. Please include the release form (attached) and mark embargo request in subject.

Nina (Legal): I have it — will review quote + release. Expect redlines in ~18-24h. If you want faster, flag as urgent.

Maria (Marketing): Perfect. I'll mark urgent for embargo. Once legal clears, we schedule the webinar slot and lock the press/email dates.

Jess (Content): FYI — drafting webinar outline: 10m customer story, 10m demo, 10m live Q&A. Will share slides by Fri for review.

Sam (Sales): I'll create the lead routing rule: webinar registrants -> SDR queue A, press interest -> AE team.

Maria (Marketing): Great. Action items: 1) Owen send data pack (done). 2) Jess finalize transcript (post-interview). 3) Legal (Nina) return redlines. 4) Maria finalize webinar slot after legal clears.

Nina (Legal): Redlines will be in your inbox within 24h. If anyone adds new quote text after that, please re-loop legal.

Maria (Marketing): Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll follow-up with calendar invites and the legal cover email.

Jess (Content): Thanks — looking forward to this.
